AchtungDieKurve.observation: Blue's live trail turned from 120° to 144° as its head moved. Gold continued on its original heading of 178°.

AdvanceWars.observation: Played Field Training, mission 1, Troop Orders. On the battlefield, moved the hand cursor across tiles under native arrow input; pressing A on an unrequested unit/ground triggered Nell’s “No, not there” correction and another prompt. Unit travel and battle resolution remain unverified.

Astray.observation: Held Right during active play. The simulated ball moved from x=1 to x=1.01229.

Backgammon.observation: Rolled 4 and 1 and moved a white checker from point 24 to the highlighted legal point 23. The board’s checker counts changed.

Balatro.observation: Started an Ante 1 Small Blind game with target 300, initial four hands/four discards and an eight-card hand. D-pad and Z lifted a chosen card, switched the blue/red hand preview to Hi-Card and played it into the scoring area.

BaldisBasics.observation: Entered Story Mode with zero of seven notebooks. Holding W moved through the hall and D strafed, changing the view of the fixed exit sign and doors. The repaired wrapper fit across all four tested viewport sizes. An optional Unity analytics request was blocked.

BasketRandom.observation: Right team jumped after the native Up input. Default embedded ad cancellation and both menu clicks completed without a page error.

BitLife.observation: Started a new life and aged twice. Closed the age-two flu event and opened Relationships, which displayed the parents and a pet.

Blackout.observation: Selected Capture the Flag and Office in the normal menu. The match HUD showed Office Tower, two flags, and a three-capture win condition. The software WebGPU run lost its GPU instance during shader compilation before weapon input could be verified.

BloonsTD.observation: Chose Bloons TD 1 through the hub and New Game. Selected the brown dart tower from Build Towers and placed it on the grass inside the bend. The tower appeared with a range circle and upgrade/sell controls, and money dropped from 650 to 400 while lives remained 40.

Bowling.observation: Used the aim control to move the release position from 0 to 0.07, then pressed Space to begin the roll.

BrainrotBoulevard.observation: The normal mobile start button entered the boulevard. Tapping pause from the running HUD opened the game menu.

BulletHell.observation: The ship moved right from x=300 to x=308 while firing. Pressing C consumed one bomb (2 to 1).

BurritoBison.observation: Advanced through the story, dragged the wrestler away from the ropes and released to launch. Clicked the in-flight slam prompt and reached the post-run mission panel.

Capital Drive.observation: In normal 3D Free roam, W then D moved the vehicle 5.754 m, changed heading by 0.079 radians and reached 39 km/h in second gear. Build 385c082ce2af reported no page exception or external request. Separately, the 2D campaign test used seeded introductory progress and switched between the direct radio route and Milo’s longer case-table handover.

Checkers.observation: Moved the piece from square 40 to 33 and observed both board squares change.

Chess Workshop.observation: The legal move and an independent Stockfish reply appeared in notation.

Circuit Ward.observation: Live player Z coordinate moved after holding W in a solo wave.

Citisten3D.observation: Opening the active town menu with Escape paused the city simulation, changing its actual time multiplier from 1 to 0.

CookieClickerHacked.observation: The first normal cookie click changed the visible counter from zero to one.

CribbageClassic.observation: Picking a face-down card revealed the opening cut. The game awarded the first crib with the message “You drew the lower card! You get the first crib.”

Crossword.observation: Submitted the matching answer for an across clue. The solved count increased from 0 of 16 to 1 of 16.

CrushTheCastle.observation: Old renderer showed an unsupported Flash prompt and remained black after Run Anyway. The shared August 2026 Ruffle reached Play, New Game and Castle 1. Two pointer inputs started and released the first shot, changing the live camera from the emplacement to the castle and producing the reload prompt.

CutTheRope.observation: Clicked Play and dragged across the first rope. Om Nom received the candy with three stars. The result showed 5,439 points, then the Next button advanced.

Dive Trivia.observation: One valid entry in a daily round scored points and revealed the submitted answer.

DogeMiner.observation: Clicked through the four-stage introduction and mined once. The mined counter increased from 0 to 1.

Dominoes.observation: Selected the first domino and placed it in the empty first slot with native keyboard input.

DoodleJump.observation: Selected Play. ArrowRight moved the player horizontally while the avatar continued its automatic jump.

DoodleJumpHacked.observation: Selected Play. ArrowRight moved the player horizontally during the automatic jump.

DrMario.observation: A fresh one-player Level 00 bottle showed four viruses. Holding Right moved the active red capsule across the top of the bottle; Z rotated its orientation and pressing Down advanced the piece toward the viruses.

DriftBoss.observation: Held Space through the driving tutorial. The car turned right and activated checkpoint two. Releasing the key registered the next steering direction.

DuckHunt.observation: A visible duck awarded points in normal Level 1. P paused the game and C opened the same-origin creator, whose form launched the named custom level.

FancyPantsAdventure3.observation: Clicked Play Now in World 3, advanced the bedroom dialogue with Up, and used S at the prompt to jump from the bed. The next frame shows Fancy Pants in the air above the window; left input then moved the hero across the floor toward the bedroom door. The original software-GPU attempt timed out taking its first frame.

FireboyAndWatergirl.observation: Horizontal movement of real Phaser level character while holding the right arrow.

FireboyAndWatergirlCrystalTemple.observation: Horizontal movement of real Phaser level character while holding the right arrow.

FireboyAndWatergirlCrystalTempleHacked.observation: Horizontal movement of real Phaser level character while holding the right arrow.

FireboyAndWatergirlForestTemple.observation: Right arrow moved Fireboy while Watergirl stayed still in the first Forest Temple level.

FireboyAndWatergirlForestTempleHacked.observation: Horizontal movement of real Phaser level character while holding the right arrow.

FireboyAndWatergirlHacked.observation: Horizontal movement of real Phaser level character while holding the right arrow.

FleeingTheComplex.observation: The original software-graphics run remained near the start of its preloader after two minutes. With the shared current Ruffle Canvas renderer the PLAY button appeared, the game reached Holding B, and the native Play Dead choice caused the branch-specific Fail screen (“Pretty convincing there”, unique 1, fail count 1). Retry was then selected.

Foldwild.observation: Selected a starter, entered the world and focused the normal game canvas. Holding W moved the active player from z=16 to z=15.4.

Frogger.observation: The full 320 × 480 board fit in three viewports. ArrowRight on desktop and one Hop right tap in portrait and landscape each moved the visible frog from x=159 to x=209.

GeometryDashLite.observation: Selected Stereo Madness in Normal Mode and started Attempt 1. A native pointer press sent the cube into a rotating airborne pose. Esc opened the in-level pause menu and the game recorded a new 3% normal-mode best.

Getaway.observation: Pressed H during an active chase. The HUD changed to Engine off · dark and the pursuit clock and minimap advanced. This cloud GPU rendered the 3D world white.

Gladihoppers.observation: Entered the Trainer’s native Unity tutorial. Holding A completed its requested movement and opened the lesson on stances.

HeartsClassic.observation: Received a 13-card hand, picked three cards and confirmed the pass. Selected a legal card and clicked Go to play it.

Hextris.observation: Started the round, rotated the main hex from lane 0 to 1 with Left, then returned to lane 0 with Right.

InfiltratingTheAirship.observation: Reached Operation ready for launch, started the live airship introduction and chose Sticky Hand from the four entry routes. Henry hung from the pink hand on the outside of the ship, and the game advanced to a new set of choices inside the Toppat cargo hold.

Jankolock.observation: The active match changed the ability from “Receipt Rush / ready” to “Receipt Rush / 7.9s” and disabled it during cooldown.

Jankolock3D.observation: Normal free movement changed the live hero controller horizontal position.

JavaScriptRacer.observation: Held the accelerator. The dashboard speed reached 20 mph.

JetpackJoyride.observation: Held the flight control after starting the run. The player rose by more than five world units.

JetpackJoyrideHacked.observation: Held the flight control after starting the run. The player rose by more than five world units.

Joust.observation: ArrowRight moved the rider from x=100 to x=110.67. Space changed vertical velocity from +38.04 to −191.85.

KirbyAmazingMirror.observation: Entered File 1, reached the opening gate with the playable pink Kirby and three companions, and used Z to jump. The last image shows Kirby above the ground while the companions remain below.

LunarLander.observation: Applied thrust and turned right. The lander and visible exhaust extended from 20 to 29 pixels high, shifted laterally and drew 111 inked pixels instead of 76.

MarioKartSuperCircuit.observation: First run selected Luigi and Peach Circuit. In a fresh second run selected Peach, 50cc Star Cup. Reached Lap 1/3 in eighth position at a standing start, then held A and steered. The kart yaws, moves away from its start position, and the race clock advances to 00:01.95.

Mastermind.observation: Entered 1, 2, 3 and 4, then pressed Enter. The game advanced to guess 2 of 8.

MegaManZero.observation: Chose New Game, completed the rescue opening, and reached an active Zero with a health meter. Right moved Zero into the Pantheon group. The jump key sent Zero up above the rocks and the B button produced a combat impact immediately afterward. Repeated input returned Zero to ground among the enemies.

MergeCatsDefender.observation: Entered the first battle and placed a Tabby Gunner in a previously empty tower slot.

MergeCatsDefenderHacked.observation: Entered the first battle and placed a Tabby Gunner in a previously empty tower slot.

MetroidFusion.observation: Started File A, followed Samus through the X infection and BSL approach, and reached the live Quarantine Bay briefing. After dismissing that briefing, the HUD read Energy 99. Right turned/moved Samus right; the subsequent A raised her from the platform into a jump, then she landed.

MissileCommand.observation: Fired a countermeasure at a clear part of the sky. The white detonation at the clicked area increased from 0 to 570 bright pixels.

Ovo.observation: Native Right moved the registered OvO 1.4.5 player horizontally on level 1; its vertical coordinate stayed fixed.

Pacman.observation: Started a round with N after audio initialization. Right-direction input moved the yellow player from x=115 to x=168.

PapasPizzeria.observation: Created an empty-slot profile, skipped the intro, visited all four tutorial stations, and took Cooper’s order. The live game produced ticket 001 with four toppings, cut instructions and a bake time. Cooking and serving that order to completion were not tested.

QWOP.observation: The two left-leg controls changed the runner’s thigh angle from 1.57 to 1.35 radians. A completed race was not tested.

Qix.observation: ArrowUp moved the player from y=597 to y=592. The shipped game describes itself as a drawing prototype.

RetroBowl.observation: Started an original Buffalo career, selected the favorite-team checkbox, skipped the introductory office tutorial, and entered the Week 18 match against New York J. Started the opening kickoff from Get Ready. Quarter clock, possession and score then advanced; a Buffalo field goal made it 3–0. This run did not verify a manual offensive pass.

RetroBowlHacked.observation: Set the favorite-team checkbox, started a new Buffalo franchise as coach Devonta Lumpkin, and entered Week 18 against New York J in the modified edition. Native input started the kickoff; the clock went from 2:00 to 1:50 as New York J began its possession. The modified banner was visible. A manually completed pass and the advertised credit/salary display were not tested.

Run3.observation: Started Explore from the native character menu. The runner entered the tunnel, then received left, right and jump inputs. The play and steer frames show the live level.

SameGame.observation: Clicked adjacent matching colours to select and remove the group. The board changed after the second click.

SchoolyardCourtyardCast.observation: Space launched the next character from the normal court. The throw queue advanced.

SchoolyardGapGlide.observation: Space started flight from a stationary Ready state. The HUD switched to Gliding.

ServerSurvival.observation: Clicked Sandbox Mode and placed a DNS service using the tools and grid. The service count increased from zero to one and the budget fell from $2,000 to $1,950.

Slipstream Borough.observation: Using the accelerator increased the live car speed in a race.

Slope.observation: The offline-unavailable notice returned to the arcade through its real Back to Arcade link. The game engine was intentionally removed from this unlisted entry.

Snake.observation: Steered, toggled pause and resume with P, crashed and started a new game.

SnakeHacked.observation: Steered, toggled pause and resume and crossed a wrapping boundary.

SoccerRandom.observation: Releasing the Up arrow after a hold lifted the right team’s players. The other pair stayed on the ground.

SonicAdvance.observation: Selected Game Start and entered a playable beach stage as Amy Rose. Holding Right moved Amy past a palm and scrolled new terrain into view. Pressing A sent her into the air, she landed, and another A produced the second jump. Stage timer advanced from 00:00.35 to 00:03.82.

StealBasketballer.observation: World avatar moved after W from a fresh profile.

StealFootballer.observation: World avatar moved after W from a fresh profile.

StrandedInIsekai.observation: Entered map 1 and moved the active character using an arrow key.

StreetFighter2.observation: Selected Arcade, Ryu and normal speed. The fight against Ken opened with both health bars and running clock. ArrowUp changed player Ryu from a grounded stance to an airborne pose. Follow-up directional and attack button inputs were accepted in that match.

SubwaySurfers.observation: Cleared local onboarding, started a run with Space and tap, and used upward input. The score advanced from 5 to 35 to 44 while the player continued along the track.

SubwaySurfersHacked.observation: Started a fresh run, steered against a barrier, then opened pause and observed the mission score of 44.

Superhot.observation: Advanced the introduction to the first 3D encounter. WASD and mouse input moved the camera in the scene with the opponent and reticle visible.

Tanks and Soldiers.observation: Live rifle ammunition count decreased after F.

TempleRun2.observation: Paused an active run, confirmed Restart, and saw score 5,526 and distance 552 reset to zero. One session also showed an empty-cloud course and an undefined track-definition exception. Two fresh runs did not reproduce it. Jumping and collisions remain unverified.

TenMinutesTillDawn.observation: Selected Shana and the revolver, entered survival and held the left mouse button. Displayed ammunition fell from 006/006 to 005/006 as the timer counted down. One optional Steam wishlist navigation was blocked offline.

TowerDefense.observation: Selected the normal turret in the palette and clicked grid tile (4,2). The empty tile gained 262 green turret pixels.

TronLightCycles.observation: Turned the blue light cycle downward with S. Its heading changed from [1, 0] to [0, 1] and its trail grew from 2 to 5 cells.

Vex7.observation: Holding D in the playable tutorial hub moved the character X -150 to -132. Horizontal speed rose from zero to 3.6 while the character stayed on the same platform.

VolleyRandom.observation: Releasing the Up arrow after a hold lifted the right team’s players. The other pair stayed on the ground.

Wings.observation: Clicking the flying F/A-18F fired one Vulcan round. Live magazine read 600 before and 599 immediately afterward. Chromium timed out on in-flight screenshot compositing; per-action diagnostic readings and menu screenshots are available.
